title: model-catalog: add compatibility flags, pricing & limits to capability endpoints; OpenAI-compat updates
author: Sasha Patel
description: This PR extends the model catalog /capabilities and /models endpoints to surface per-model compatibility flags (openai_compat, streaming_supported, function_calling, structured_output_schema), pricing and rate/size limits, and filter/query parameters to enable clients and the OpenAI-compat layer to make deterministic routing and UI decisions. Motivation: product and SDK teams need stable capability signals and cost/limit metadata to implement adaptive routing, streaming fallbacks, structured output validation, and accurate cost estimation in Redwood Console and client SDKs. Changes include: 1) API response additions: new top-level fields capability_flags (list), pricing (per_token_generation, per_token_input, per_embedding), limits (max_context_tokens, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, rps, rpm), and compatibility_notes (string). 2) Query/filter additions: supports query params filter[capability]=openai_compat|streaming|function_calling|structured_output and min_context_tokens/max_cost filters for client-side discovery. 3) OpenAI-compat layer updates: prefer models with openai_compat=true and explicit structured_output_schema when a client requests modelType=openai; fallbacks added for streaming vs polling with clear signals. 4) Streaming stability: annotated models with streaming_supported=false will cause gateway to disable chunked transfer for those variants; added server-side max-stream-chunk-size and heartbeat hints. 5) SDK and docs: updated TS/Python SDK type mappings and added example for filtering models by capabilities and consuming pricing and limits. 6) Backwards compat: all new fields are additive; older clients will ignore unknown fields but we added a small opt-in header X-Redwood-Expose-Capabilities for conservative rollouts. See release notes below. Implementation notes: DB schema adds two columns (capability_flags as text array, pricing as jsonb) with a lightweight migration that backfills pricing from model registry heuristics; runtime checks ensure the capability flags are authoritative at query time. Feature rollout: gated by feature flag model_catalog_extended_metadata and enabled globally after 72h smoke tests. See Linear ENG-1427 for rollout checklist.

release_notes: Add per-model capability flags (openai_compat, streaming_supported, function_calling, structured_output_schema), pricing and rate/size limits to model catalog endpoints; new query filters for capability discovery; opt-in header X-Redwood-Expose-Capabilities for conservative rollout; SDK updates to expose pricing and structured output schema.
